QF.id: VII Introduction to Securities Broking Operations_46

question.text: STT on sale of equity-oriented mutual fund units settled by delivery on a recognized exchange is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Sale of a unit of an equity-oriented fund entered into on a recognized stock exchange and settled by actual delivery is taxed at 0.001%, payable by the seller. The Trap: Equity share delivery STT is 0.1% and non-delivery equity STT is 0.025%; STT also does not apply to currency/interest-rate derivatives and debt securities transactions. Note: The 0.001% rate is specific to equity-oriented mutual fund units settled by delivery.
